barcodedTn5Config.title: Barcoded Tn5 Config
barcodedTn5Config.description: [PUBLIC] File path to a CSV file that specifies the TIs and FASTQs assigned to each sample. If running a cATAC workflow, and no config file is provided, the default behavior is to merge all TIs and FASTQs as a single sample. Only include TIs present in a given experiment as unused TIs that are included in the config can lead to errors. Must be formatted with these three columns: 1. Sample The name of the sample. 2. Fastq The name given to the fastq file pair. 3. TI The name of the TI used (see conf/atac_preset.config for preset list).
barcodedTn5Config.help_text: File path to a CSV file that specifies the TIs and FASTQs assigned to each sample. barcodedTn5Config.errorMessage: The 'barcodedTn5Config' parameter must be a file path to a CSV file.
